mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals labor market tightness that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 1% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) during supply-driven expansion phases reflects manufacturing strength that supports corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises month-over-month during supply-driven expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output that precedes higher corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that elevates consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth (GDPC1) during post-recession recovery phases indicates sustained economic expansion that improves corporate earnings outlook, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during the post-recession recovery phase, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
